requiredCriteria.statement: SYS-API-021 through 025 and 057 through 068 use the exact closed request response Problem receipt headers status and route contracts without browser-supplied tenant authority.

IAQ-057 and IAQ-062 derive from one owner query and persistence truth, return the same itemPublicId and EFFECTIVE_STATUS revision, retain owner receipt only as non-serialized server lineage, and receive no duplicate implementation or completion credit.

Both IAQs enforce their distinct field groups, exact filters, eight sorts, limit 1 through 100, stable itemPublicId order, revision-bound cursor and COMPLETE EMPTY PARTIAL UNAVAILABLE state invariants.
The seven-layer PEP chain and field-policy decision execute before serialization; VIEW MASK OMIT and server action descriptors cannot be bypassed by direct calls or client inference.
Connector and mapping subject data are immutable versions and validate test or dry-run submit approve activate transitions require current digest evidence separate actors and expected-revision CAS.
Static and dynamic separation of duties reject self approval self activation and execution of an own unapproved mapping across the same tenant connector set and legal entity.

Connection tests and dry-runs neither dispatch production provider effects nor write domain data; endpoint allowlisting SSRF and DNS-rebinding defenses plus tenant connector purpose type namespace digest and authorization binding reject cross-tenant or arbitrary opaque-reference substitution without secret or provider payload exposure.

Execution acceptance atomically freezes definition version mapping version endpoint policy secret revision source item-set digest provider idempotency key authorization revision and the original command receipt; a tenant connector provider-operation unique key and monotonic attempt fence prevent duplicate or stale-worker provider effects.
A provider timeout becomes durable RESULT_UNKNOWN and may be reconciled only with the original provider key and receipt evidence; blind redispatch and a new provider key are rejected.

Retry creates new attempts for the exact retryable failed-item set only and never replays successful items or changes their mapping; cancel is direct only before dispatch and otherwise requires explicit compensation.

SYS-EVT-005 is validated and appended atomically with the execution transition, uses eventId dedupe, exposes only public execution state counts and reconciliation digest, and excludes secrets raw payload and employee identity.

The six Platform-owned tables pass V333-to-V334 and clean-V334 migration checks, tenant RLS and ACL negatives, composite-FK tests, direct-SQL immutable-version and execution-item-attempt invalid-transition terminal-overwrite delete result-unknown-regression success-replay compensation-bypass negatives, provider-key uniqueness and stale-fence negatives, append-only shared-receipt terminal-transition guards, checksum preservation and forbidden-column scanning.

The HRIS Settings and DWP Control UI variants use the same workbench owner truth, preserve product HCM deep links, separate read and command errors, and render no commands for stale partial unavailable or denied evidence.
The UI passes keyboard screen-reader 1440 1280 390 and 320 pixel layouts 200 percent zoom light dark forced-colors and reduced-motion checks without nested main landmarks.
The feature remains default OFF with zero enrolled tenants zero real providers zero route or menu activation and zero SYS-008 API calls when not authorized or not mounted.
